items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or new production work. Revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and no monthly spend, revenue, or budget limits are recorded. Minimum measurement is one reconciled period-aligned ledger covering site/content identifier, revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/domain/marketing cost, exposure, and incremental outcome. Keep the existing finance reconciliation only and do not treat missing telemetry as zero.

Handoff: continue the existing measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed, reconcile the conflicting AI-cost records, and add period-aligned infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and budget records where already available. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests, calculate cost-to-learn from clicks or impressions alone, or infer financial return from SEO, sessions, conversions, performance scores, or vanity metrics.

Handoff: retain the CRO and SEO opportunities as deferred backlog only. No item has supported revenue attribution, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, or payback evidence sufficient to justify spend or production work. Reconsider only after the existing failure repair-or-close review, measurement capacity, and financial reconciliation are complete.
